title: File Runner: Reads Source, Runs Pipeline, Handles Errors
description: run_file(filename) reads source from file, calls run(source) (the full pipeline: lex, parse, evaluate), prints result. Catches FileNotFoundError and three interpreter errors (LexError, ParseError, RuntimeError_), prints to stderr, exits with code 1. Entry point for running .mini files.

steps.description: Import sys for exit codes and stderr.
run_file opens file, reads all source. FileNotFoundError prints message and exits with code 1.
Calls run(source) (defined elsewhere: lex -> parse -> evaluate). On success prints result. Catches LexError, ParseError, RuntimeError_, prints to stderr, exits 1.
Three error types map to three pipeline stages: LexError (tokenize), ParseError (parse), RuntimeError_ (evaluate). Single except clause handles all, unified error UX.

steps.question: If run(source) raises a RuntimeError_ from a divide-by-zero in the evaluator, what does the user see?
steps.answer: The except clause catches it, prints 'Error: [eval:line] division by zero' to stderr, exits with code 1. The line number comes from the AST node's line field.
